text.releaseNotes:
✨ Mermaid diagrams on this page

Pages often hold Mermaid as plain code blocks, from Markdown imports, AI tools or other apps. Open the page's ••• menu and choose Apps → Mermaid diagrams on this page to see every one of them drawn as a diagram. Nothing on the page changes.

  • Finds code blocks marked mermaid, untagged code blocks that start with a diagram type such as flowchart or sequenceDiagram, and ```mermaid fences written as text
  • Open any diagram full screen with zoom, copy its source, or download it as PNG or SVG
  • Works on pages, blog posts and Live Docs, for everyone who can view the page

🔁 Convert code blocks into diagrams

If you can edit the page, the same window lets you pick blocks and click Convert. Each one becomes a Mermaid Diagrams macro in the same place, with the same code, so everyone sees the diagram on the page.

  • One new page version, saved under your name as a minor edit
  • Undo right after converting, or restore the earlier version from page history
  • If someone published the page while you were reviewing it, or it has unpublished changes, nothing is changed and the window tells you why
  • A block with a syntax error still converts, so you can fix it in the diagram editor

👋 New to Mermaid Diagrams?

On a page without Mermaid, Insert an example diagram adds a small flowchart at the end of the page to start from.

No new permissions are requested, and nothing leaves Atlassian: the page is read and updated as the person using the window.

✨ Mermaid 12

Diagrams now render with Mermaid 12.1, the same engine as the official Mermaid Live Editor. Code you copy from mermaid.live renders the same on your pages, and the other way round.

  • New default look (neo) and colors (redux-color) for flowchart, sequence, class, state, ER and requirement diagrams
  • ELK layout by default: tidier diagrams with fewer crossing lines
  • New themes, each with a dark variant, and the hand-drawn look
  • Diagrams without a theme follow each reader's light or dark mode
  • More diagram types, including Kanban, packet, use case and Venn diagrams

☁️ Architecture diagrams with icons

Draw cloud and service architecture with product logos (logos:aws-lambda, logos:kubernetes) and general icons (mdi:server). The icons ship inside the app, so nothing is loaded from outside Atlassian.

⚡ Faster snippet gallery

Snippet previews are pre-rendered, so the gallery opens instantly. New snippets show architecture icons and the theme, look and layout settings.

Existing diagrams look different?

Mermaid 12 changed its default look and layout, as in every app that uses it. Your diagram code is unchanged. To bring back the previous layout and shapes, add a config block with layout: dagre and look: classic at the top of the diagram: docs.apportunity.xyz/mermaid-diagrams/diagram-theming#keep-the-previous-look

Mermaid 12 needs Safari 17.4 or later, or a current Chrome, Edge or Firefox.

🤖 Create Pages with AI

Ask an AI assistant to write a Confluence page, and get the diagrams already drawn on it. Describe what you want once, and the page appears with the explanation and the diagram in place. Nobody has to open the macro and paste anything in.

Works with the Apportunity Secure MCP Server, which lets assistants such as Claude create Confluence pages using your own permissions.

  • Your edits always win: once you edit a diagram in Confluence, it is yours and cannot be overwritten by a regenerated page
  • Pages created this way export to PDF and Word as normal
  • Great for turning a discussion, a runbook, or existing code into documented diagrams

Full guide with ready-made prompts: docs.apportunity.xyz/mermaid-diagrams/create-pages-with-ai
